flow-definition.description: Play&Say GitHub push webhook router. Owns the shared Generic Webhook Trigger token and forwards each accepted branch event to exactly one internal dispatcher.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BRANCH_NAME
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Git branch received from GitHub push event.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: FORCE_TARGETS
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Optional manual override forwarded to the internal dispatcher.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: MAX_PARALLEL_MODULE_JOBS
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Maximum downstream module jobs forwarded to the internal dispatcher; allowed range is 1..4.
